claim: Week 46 of 2026: a leadership shock at the largest AI chipmaker, a new kind of model from Google, and the price range of the largest AI listing yet.

support.quote: Anthropic expects to price the offering on November 18 and begin trading on November 19, and is targeting a retail allocation of about 20%, well above the norm for an IPO, CNBC reported, citing people familiar with the details.

claim: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's president, chief executive officer and director on November 12, 2026, effective immediately.

support.quote: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) Board of Directors announced today that Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately.

claim: Google launched the Gemini Decisions API and its Gemini Decision 1 model on November 11, 2026.

support.quote: Today, we’re introducing the Gemini Decisions API, a new endpoint for fast, closed-set decisions powered by our new Gemini Decision 1 model (gemini-decision-1), available through the Gemini API in Google AI Studio.

claim: It costs $0.10 per million input tokens, and output tokens are free.

support.quote: Gemini Decision 1 is priced at $0.10 per 1M input tokens and $0 for output tokens, with an API no-cost tier you can use in Google AI Studio for prototyping.

claim: An updated filing showed on November 10, 2026 that Anthropic plans to sell 825 million shares at $70 to $78 each on Nasdaq, which could raise up to about $64.4 billion.

support.quote: Anthropic plans to sell 825 million shares at $70 to $78 each in its Nasdaq IPO, which could raise up to about $64.4 billion, an updated filing shows.

claim: Nvidia, Google and other partners agreed to buy $26 billion of stock in a private placement alongside the offering, Decrypt reported.

support.quote: Nvidia, Google, AMD, Broadcom, Micron, Microsoft and TSMC have agreed to buy $26 billion of non-voting stock at the IPO price in a concurrent private placement.

claim: The company expects to price the shares on November 18, 2026 and start trading the next day, according to CNBC as cited by Decrypt.

support.quote: Anthropic expects to price the offering on November 18 and begin trading on November 19, and is targeting a retail allocation of about 20%, well above the norm for an IPO, CNBC reported, citing people familiar with the details.
